newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Washington County, Md..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Washington County, Md..

text.p: Proposals will be received by the Director of the Office of Budget and Finance of Washington County, Maryland, at the offices of The Chapman Company, World Trade Center, 28th Floor, 401 East Pratt Street, Baltimore, Maryland 21202 until NOON EST on Tuesday,

for the purchase of the above referenced bonds of the County Commissioners of Washington County, all dated March 15, 1997, all bearing interest payable on July 1, 1997 (three and one-half months), and semiannually thereafter on January 1 and July 1 until maturity or earlier redemption. The bonds will mature in various amounts from January 1, 1998 through January 1, 2017.

Proposals may be submitted either directly or by facsimile transmission, and the good faith deposit may be in the form of either a certified or cashier's check or a financial surety bond, all as further described in the Official Notice of Sale.

The Preliminary Official Statement, together with the Official Notice of Sale and Proposal For Bonds, will be supplied to prospective bidders upon request made in writing to Paul M. Heid at the financial advisor for the issuance of the bonds, The Chapman Company, World Trade Center, 28th Floor, 401 East Pratt Street, Baltimore, Maryland 21202, or by telephone, (410) 625-9656 or by facsimile transmission, (410) 625-9313.
